description: File a confidential consultation request with the firm on behalf of a person who has agreed to it. Goes through the same intake as the website contact form; the firm calls or emails back. Not for marketing or solicitation.

company_size.description: Approximate number of employees at the employer

consent.description: Must be true: the person has agreed to send these details to the law firm.

location.description: City and state where they work or worked

name.description: Full name of the person seeking help

phone.description: Callback phone number with area code. A phone or an email is required.

site.description: Which office/site to send it to, e.g. riversideemploymentlawyer.com. Use list_offices to choose the nearest. Defaults to the Los Angeles office.

situation.description: What happened at work, in the person's own words

termination_date.description: Date of termination if any, YYYY-MM-DD

name: request_consultation
title: Request a consultation
